Changes made in this snapshot after the copy (the manifest lists the ORIGINAL hashes)
====================================================================================

1. Shared upstream modules (2026-10-13)

Ten modules of the Sphere-Packing-Lean port are also part of the Riesz library, ported from the
same upstream commit under the same declaration names:

  SpherePacking.CohnElkies.PoissonSummationGeneral                    = Riesz.PoissonLattice
  SpherePacking.CohnElkies.PoissonSummationLattices.PoissonSummation  = Riesz.PoissonStandardLattice
  SpherePacking.CohnElkies.PoissonSummationLattices.UnitAddTorus      = Riesz.PoissonTorus
  SpherePacking.CohnElkies.PoissonSummationSchwartz.Basic             = Riesz.PoissonSchwartzBasic
  SpherePacking.CohnElkies.PoissonSummationSchwartz.PoissonSummation  = Riesz.PoissonSchwartz
  SpherePacking.ForMathlib.BoundsOnIcc                                = Riesz.BoundsOnIcc
  SpherePacking.ForMathlib.FourierLinearEquiv                         = Riesz.FourierLinearEquiv
  SpherePacking.ForMathlib.RadialSchwartz.Cutoff                      = Riesz.RadialCutoff
  SpherePacking.ForMathlib.RadialSchwartz.Multidimensional            = Riesz.RadialMultidimensional
  SpherePacking.ForMathlib.RadialSchwartz.OneSided                    = Riesz.RadialSchwartz

A Lean file cannot import two modules that declare the same name, so a module of this project
that uses both libraries needs one copy.  The ten files above are kept here unmodified but are
NOT built and NOT imported; their only importers outside the ten are redirected to the Riesz
modules:

    patched  sha256 7df8aa037998257833496995073420255ce0d9bfde96f275234e4a225060e03a

2. Toolchain port (2026-10-13)

The snapshot was written for Lean 4.33.1 and Mathlib 0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474; this
project compiles it with Lean 4.34.1 and Mathlib d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612.  The
entries below are all the changes made for that.  They change proofs only: tactic scripts, lemma
names, `simp` sets, explicit arguments, and Mathlib import lines.  No statement of a theorem was
changed, no declaration was added, removed or renamed, and the `decide +kernel` certificates and
the generated data of the `Kron*` modules were not touched.
3 of the changed places are inside `def`s (`StationaryPointProcess.dilate`,
`StationaryPointProcess.deleteClose`, `StationaryPointProcess.deletedClose`): each of them changes
only the proof of a proposition-valued structure field; the data fields and the types are unchanged.

Not a change of this snapshot, but relevant for reading its statements with the newer Mathlib:
between the two Mathlib revisions the junk values of two definitions changed.
`MeasureTheory.Measure.map f μ` for a non-a.e.-measurable `f` was `0` and is now `0` if `μ = 0`
and a Dirac mass otherwise (Mathlib #42322); `MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ` for a `f` that is not
a.e. strongly measurable is now `∞`, and `MemLp f p μ` is defined as `eLpNorm f p μ < ∞`
(Mathlib #42406).  The statements of the snapshot that mention them are textually unchanged.

`-` lines are the original text (as in the manifest), `+` lines the text used here; line numbers
refer to the original file.  13 files, 14 changed places.
